correctness.rationale: All quantified claims concern fixed finite positive nonuniform iid letter masses and all positive word lengths. The unique shortest border is unbordered and nonoverlapping, giving disjoint exact weighted kernels. Central-insertion bijections prove the odd/even weighted unbordered recurrence, including the squared-weight square correction. The two-sided iid coupling has defective success masses \(b_\ell\) with \(h<1\) by a positive-probability mismatch event. An exponential moment of the total successful peeled length supplies explicit geometric limiting law, exponential total-variation and all fixed moment bounds; direct rational exhaustive tests were executed via verify.py for three binary distributions through length 12, ternary through length 8, and independent weighted recurrences.

originality.rationale: The closest primary papers prove the greedy deterministic factorization and complete UNIFORM width counts and uniform mean convergence. All uniform consequences are conceded to their stronger theorem, while the asserted contribution is a distinct NONUNIFORM iid law with exact weighted bivariate generating function, multivariate squared-weight recurrence, exponential geometric limit and all moment rates. Period/longest-border random-word literature has a different statistic. Full-text and semantic searches produced no direct coverage. Unindexed weighted renewal results remain a real residual risk.
residual_risks: A nonuniform analogue might appear implicitly in unindexed renewal-process or weighted-string literature.
The general weighted-unbordered recursion may have appeared independently even though it was not found in inspected papers.
No claim of universal publication priority or independent scientific certification is made.

value.rationale: Biased iid models are a natural nonuniform extension of the same word-factorization invariant: probability profiles depend on symbols, not just word length. The theorem gives an exact bivariate probability law, computable multivariate weighted unbordered recurrence with nontrivial squaring corrections, full geometric asymptotic distribution with an exponential total-variation bound, and all moment rates. It resolves this model for every finite positive nonuniform source rather than a narrow numeric slice, and clarifies the sharp distinction from the already known uniform counting theory.
